summary: Iteration 163 — tested the new shared lab shift-state backend (GET/PUT /api/lab/shift-state, anonymous access, persistence, validation) with 6 pytest cases (6/6 PASS) and end-to-end UI verification of BraccioLab, Emergenze and RicettaDelGiorno on mobile viewport (390x844). All requested feature flows work: work_mode toggle persists across reload/new sessions via shared backend doc; machine-down and cold-down rules generate the correct recalculation notes; emergency banner + warning dot appear on BraccioLab and disappear after 'New shift' + restore; RicettaDelGiorno shows plan items after admin login, opens detail with large doses, batch status grid works and 'precotto' feeds the Bases & Pre-baked summary in both RicettaDelGiorno and Emergenze. One real blocking overlay was found (first-run Lab Voice onboarding card covers the 3 quick keys in the zero-scroll BraccioLab). No console errors, no 5xx during the whole run.

minor.issue: Fully unauthenticated write to a single shared document (_key='default') with no rate limit: any anonymous client can overwrite the whole shift state of the bakery. Accepted per user choice, but consider at least a soft guard/audit field (last_writer).

ui_bugs.issue: First-run 'Lab Voice' onboarding card (fixed inset-x-3 bottom-28 z-[60]) intercepts pointer events over the 3 quick keys (braccio-quick-*) and the braccio-gestione button. Playwright normal click failed with 'subtree intercepts pointer events'; since BraccioLab is zero-scroll the keys are unreachable until the tiny X is tapped. Fix: hide voice-onboard while document.body has class 'braccio-mode' (or when the FAB is hidden).

Floating mic/audio buttons (bottom-right) visually overlap bottom content inside the Lab tools (last shift note in Emergenze, 'In cold cell' status button in rdg-detail). Content is scrollable so not blocking, but overlaps text.

integration_issues.flow: Bottom nav while a Lab tool is open
integration_issues.issue: Tapping the 'Lab' tab (nav-tab-maestro) while Emergenze/RicettaDelGiorno is open does NOT return to BraccioLab (Maestro's local `tool` state is not reset), so the emergency banner cannot be reached from the nav bar; user must use 'Back to tools'. Suggest resetting tool on nav-tab re-tap.

basesSummary uses the raw weekly-plan recipe_name (IT, e.g. 'Anima Integrale') while list/detail show the localized title ('Whole Soul (Whole Wheat Bread)') — same product appears under two different names in emg-bases / rdg-bases.

issues: Theme renders as specified (bg rgb(245,236,215), gold accents, dark text) and is truly zero-scroll (scrollHeight == innerHeight = 844)
Dark app chrome (header/bottom nav) around the cream panel is a strong contrast switch but readable — no contrast failures found
Machine card 'TEST Impastatrice QA · 50kg' is leftover seed data in lab-config from an earlier iteration — consider cleaning the mixers list

action_items: HIGH: do not render voice-onboard while BraccioLab is active (body.braccio-mode) — it blocks all 3 quick keys and the Gestione button in the zero-scroll layout.
MEDIUM: re-tapping the Lab bottom-nav tab should close the open tool and return to BraccioLab.
LOW: localize recipe_name used in basesSummary (use recipeTitle) so bases chips match the list titles.
LOW: keep the floating voice FAB from overlapping bottom content of Lab tools (extra bottom padding).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py GET /api/lab/shift-state correctly projects out _id and _key — OK. PUT accepts the full model and stamps updated_at — OK; 422 returned for wrong types (validated).
shiftState.js persist() fires api.put on every mutation with no debounce; rapid taps (e.g. status grid) generate one PUT per click on a shared doc — consider debouncing/last-write-wins guard.

shiftState.js mutate() shallow-copies arrays only; nested batch objects are spread on update so OK, but there is no server merge — two devices editing simultaneously will overwrite each other (no version/etag).
Maestro.jsx is very large (tool switch of 60+ components); consider a lazy route map to reduce bundle and re-render cost.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested flows pass; 1 blocking overlay + 3 minor issues)

seed_data_creation: Seeded one weekly-plan item (id TEST_wp1, day='mar', recipe 'Anima Integrale', 24 pcs) for admin@mikilab.de to test RicettaDelGiorno; removed afterwards. Shared shift-state reset to default {work_mode:'continuo', empty arrays} at the end (verified via GET).
test_credentials: admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — login via UI works, session_token returned by POST /api/auth/login usable as Bearer
context_for_next_testing_agent: App language in preview is EN, so Emergenze/BraccioLab texts appear translated — assert on data-testid, not Italian strings. Always click [data-testid="voice-onboard-close"] right after entering the Lab tab, otherwise the quick keys are pointer-blocked. To leave a Lab tool use [data-testid="maestro-back-btn"] (nav-tab-maestro does not reset the tool). Weekly plan is per-user (auth required): seed via PUT /api/weekly-plan as admin with day key from getDay() mapping [dom,lun,mar,mer,gio,ven,sab]. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter163_shift_state.py (run with pytest from /app/backend, pytest.ini already sets xdist).
rca_of_the_issue: Blocking overlay: VoiceCommand.jsx line ~515 renders the onboarding card as `fixed inset-x-3 bottom-28 z-[60]` and is only dismissed by the user (localStorage mikilab_voice_onboard). BraccioLab hides the voice FAB via the 'mikilab-fab' event but not this onboarding card, and its layout is height-capped (zero-scroll), so the card sits exactly on top of the 3 quick keys / Gestione button and intercepts clicks on first visit.
